settings.heading: About Wear Human Happiness
settings.subtext: We’ve created a loving home and spacious studio where our artisans have the freedom, and comfort, to work at their own pace and place.

settings.heading: Fair Trade & Ethically Made
settings.subtext: In Bali, we work hand in hand with local artisans, ensuring they’re treated with fairness, respect, and love. As a fair-trade company, we believe in fashion’s power to uplift and empower—bringing happiness and freedom to both the maker and the wearer.

settings.heading: Small Team, Quality Materials
settings.content: Working with small batches, and true craftsmanship, every legging is made to last—many of our customers have been enjoying theirs for over seven years. Our founder, Sanne, personally ensures that our beloved fabric meets our high standards, creating timeless fashion that respects both people and the planet.

settings.heading: No Sweatshops, No Child Labor
settings.content: We believe all humans should have a good quality of life, fair-pay, and excellent working conditions, which is why we collaborate exclusively with small family-run Balinese artisans. We've built them a beautiful home and spacious atelier, this way they can work freely and at their own pace.

settings.title: Unique hand-print designs
settings.description: We believe all humans should have a good quality of life, fair-pay, and excellent working conditions, which is why we collaborate exclusively with small family-run Balinese artisans. We've built them a beautiful home and spacious atelier, this way they can work freely and at their own pace.

settings.title: Naturally air-dried
settings.description: After printing, each fabric is gently draped over bamboo poles to dry naturally in the warm Balinese breeze. This slow, mindful process locks in the vibrancy and richness of the colors, ensuring they remain as bright and beautiful as the day they were made—year after year.

settings.title: Precision cut for every shape and size
settings.description: Our master tailor, Ketut Mertha, expertly cuts each piece of fabric to ensure a flawless fit. For custom orders, we create personalized templates based on your specific measurements—whether you need longer or shorter legs, we’ve got you covered.

settings.title: Balinese sewing craftsmanship
settings.description: Every piece is meticulously sewn in our Bali studio by Ketut Mertha and his family, including his wife and two brothers and sisters-in-law. As a small, family-owned operation, we take pride in supporting the local community in Bali, Indonesia. Every stitch is placed with care, ensuring the highest quality.

settings.title: Human quality control
settings.description: Every piece is personally inspected by Ketut Mertha to ensure it stands the test of time. From securing threads to the final finish, each detail is meticulously checked for enduring quality. Our commitment means customers continue to enjoy their garments for years—through countless wears - and wash after wash.
